auth.scheme: Bearer token (data.token.access_token) + 全局签名 app_key/timestamp/sign
auth.signature: sign = MD5( X + path + Σ(sorted(value-kv pairs)) + timestamp + ' ' + X )，X = hex(base64('fNR2q4ZrSdepeIrZ9HiUlQ=='))；app_key = hex(base64(reverse('==wnD0g66qYL7qDSn3ZOox46')))；path 为不含 /lab-course 前缀的接口路径
